reason: Support Reddit-linked Imgur album members using a bounded ordered API list and exact API media/rendition matching, including GIFV-to-MP4. Extend existing schema-19 bounded missing-media observations to linked album/gallery endpoints; missing albums retain post evidence without invented file receipts. Existing attachment identities, execution/capture contracts, admission meaning, coverage, cursors, producer identities and acknowledgements remain unchanged. Requires the matching server album reader before deploying these producer repairs.
